type: Computerized lockstitch machine with backstitch stepping motor, thickness detection, IoT connectivity
source: AMH2_Operation_Manual_V1.1_20250612 (A5E-B electric control box manual, 20 pages)
note: The AMH2 machine uses the A5E-B electronic control box (V1.1, June 2025). This is a more advanced variant than the AMH (A5E-A): 16-button panel, adds thickness detection (P390-P404), knee lifter rest (P336-P345), IoT connectivity (P117, P122), micro bird's nest function (P410-P445), Call key, and adapter board communication. See also A5E-B.json for earlier A5E-B documentation.

pinout.function: Suction solenoid valve / Clamping / Micro bird's nest

buttons.name: Up key (speed up)
buttons.description: 1. Add parameter number/value in the entry parameter function. 2. Initial standby down speed plus.

buttons.name: Down key (speed down)
buttons.description: 1. In the entry parameter function, parameter number/value reduction. 2. Initial standby speed reduction.

buttons.name: Left key
buttons.description: Turn to left to choose parameter.

buttons.name: Right key
buttons.description: Turn to right to choose parameter.

buttons.name: Needle distance adjustment key
buttons.description: Needle distance adjustment button. In idle state, short press add or subtract needle distance.

buttons.name: Front bar-tacking key
buttons.description: Pressed once a short time to cycle: setting front bar-tacking → front double bar-tacking → closing. LCD icon lights up. Select key to set number of stitches in segments A and B.

buttons.name: Back bar-tacking / Mode switch key
buttons.description: Back bar-tacking: Press once to cycle: setting back bar-tacking → back double bar-tacking → close. LCD icon lights up. Set stitches for segments C and D. Mode switch: Press briefly to switch sew machine mode: free sew → W sew → multi-section sew.

buttons.name: Up and down stop position key / Cutting key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to switch up/down stop position. 2. Hold down to enable the automatic cable cutting function.

buttons.name: Pattern sew key / Piecework interface key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to enter pattern sew mode. In pattern sew mode, short press to switch between pattern sew interface and pattern sew setting interface. 2. Long press to enter or exit the piece counting mode.

buttons.name: Reset key
buttons.description: Long press to back to factory setting.

buttons.name: Press foot lift key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to cycle presser foot lifting selection: on → midway on → on after trim → midway off after trim → off after trim → off. 2. Long press to quickly adjust the height of the presser foot (P173=sewing height, P174=height after cutting).

buttons.name: Thickness key
buttons.description: 1. Press to turn on or off the thickness detection function. 2. Press and hold to enter the screen for quick parameter adjustment of thickness test.

buttons.name: Clip key / Less bird's nest key
buttons.description: 1. Press to turn on the clamping function. Press again to turn off. 2. Long press and hold to turn on or off the little nest function.

buttons.name: Voice key
buttons.description: 1. Short press to toggle voice function and startup language: voice on → startup language on → startup language off → voice off. 2. Idle time press to enter multi-language switching interface. 3. Short press to broadcast voice navigation when error is reported.

buttons.name: Call key
buttons.description: When network connected: 1. Short press to call for device malfunction (displays CALL, returns to main page after 2s). 2. Long press to make production assistance call (displays HELP, returns after 2s). 3. P+Call button: turn call function off (displays OFF, returns after 2s).

userParams.access: Press P button → interface jumps to parameter mode → use Left/Right to navigate → use Up/Down to adjust → press P to save and exit
userParams.technicianEntry: Press P key to enter technician parameter mode (interface jumps to P44 parameter, all technician parameters open)

technicianParams.access: Press P key in operator mode to enter technician parameter mode

monitoringMode.access: Press P + press foot lifter key simultaneously → monitoring mode → press up/down to navigate → press P to log out (save for items 24, 25, 26, 28)
monitoringMode.upperNeedleStop: Enter monitoring item 24, adjust handwheel to up needle position, long press P to save

thicknessCalibration.access: Press and hold P key + Thickness key → Zero Position Calibration Mode
steps: Hold P + Thickness key to enter zero position calibration mode (left 3 digits show '-A-', right 4 digits show calibrated voltage)
Step on foot pedal forward — machine finds upper needle position
Voice prompt plays and calibrated value displays — press P briefly to exit

stepMotorPositionAdjust.access: Long press P + stitch length plus key → Quick Parameter Adjustment Mode → press Up/Down to switch options

parameterEntry.languageChange: Long press voice button, switch parameters with Up/Down keys. Languages: 0=English, 1=Spanish, 2=Portuguese, 3=Russian, 4=Arabic, 5=Vietnamese, 6=Persian, 7=Bengali, 8=Turkish, 9=Indonesian, 10=Polish, 11=Italian, 12=Thai language, 13=Ukrainian, 14=Chinese, 15=Korean (multi-lingual version only)
parameterEntry.factoryReset: Long press Reset key to restore all factory defaults

pieceworkMode.exit: Long press piece counting icon OR short press free sew icon
pieceworkMode.enableByDefault: Piecework function is automatically enabled by default when entering the piecework interface. Set v09=1 to enable via parameter.
pieceworkMode.clearV01: Press Right twice then press Down quickly; OR hold Down 3s on V01 interface to clear directly
pieceworkMode.standby: Press scissors button to enter standby mode (AMH machine indicator light flashes). Press again to exit.
pieceworkMode.productionDataClear: Set v13=1 to clear piece/efficiency data. Set v13=2 to restore all piecework parameters to factory defaults.

errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system power, turn on again after 30 seconds. 2. Check whether arm shaft motor encoder and electronic control are damaged or in poor conditions. 3. Contact local service provider if still fails.
Same as Err-01.

errorCodes.description: Arm shaft motor current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power, turn on again after 30 seconds. Try a few times. Contact service provider if fault occurs frequently.

1. Check for foreign objects around machine head, thread residue in rotating shuttle, stuck eccentric wheel. 2. Check input plug of arm shaft motor power supply. 3. Contact service provider if still fails.
1. Check connection between operation panel and electric control. 2. Contact service provider if still fails after restart.

errorCodes.description: Arm shaft motor initial angle detection failure
errorCodes.solution: Try 2-3 times after power off. Contact service provider if still fails.

alarmCodes.solution: Return machine head to normal position, make sure safety switch rebound

alarmCodes.description: Alarm of machine head button with short circuit
alarmCodes.solution: Turn off system power and change the light button of machine head

alarmCodes.description: Alarm when needle count reaches the full count
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key briefly to cancel the alarm. Refer to parameter P43.

alarmCodes.description: Alarm when piece count reaches the full count
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key briefly to cancel the alarm. Refer to parameter P90.

alarmCodes.description: Alarm: The thickness sensor is not connected
alarmCodes.solution: Check whether the wiring terminal of the thickness sensor is connected to the electronic control unit. Press P key briefly to cancel the alarm.

alarmCodes.description: Alarm for communication between the adapter board and the electronic control unit
alarmCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system power and power on again. If error still occurs, check if electronic control unit is damaged or upgrade adapter board program. 2. After staying on alarm interface for 10 seconds, alarm display will automatically cancel. Alternatively, press P key briefly to cancel.
1. After power switch turned off, panel displays OFF, returns to normal after turning on power. 2. Check if input voltage is too low.

troubleshooting.issue: Thickness sensor alarm (ALR-11) when thickness detection not needed
troubleshooting.cause: Thickness sensor wire disconnected or thickness detection is not required for this machine configuration
troubleshooting.solution: If thickness detection is not required, set P390=0 to disable. If required, check thickness sensor wiring at pin 5 (BH-IN) of machine head solenoid connector.

troubleshooting.cause: Adapter board disconnected or firmware mismatch
troubleshooting.solution: Power cycle first. If persists, check adapter board connection. Update adapter board firmware if available. Alarm auto-clears after 10 seconds.

troubleshooting.issue: Call key not working (network functions unavailable)
troubleshooting.solution: Check network connectivity. IoT must be enabled (P117=1) and correct channel set (P122). Call key only active when network connection is successful.
